result:
I've planned round 300: STUDIO-LINK-b, the "View in store" menu in the Studio library. Decision is **CONTINUE**. I didn't modify the store repo (`git status` is empty) and wrote only to the loop folder; the round-299 task is archived (copied) as `tasks/round-299.md`.

**Round 299 result**
- C passed all 12 rows, with real browser checks at both viewports. Gate 299 published `61c37d8`, which is the new baseline.
- That closes C-R298-01, GATE297-F1, GATE297-S5, GATE298-S3, GATE298-S1 and A-R298-REVIEW-5.
- A's reviewer rated A-R299-REVIEW-1 Medium; I ruled it and REVIEW-2…4 Low and deferred them. No failure was reproduced, they only affect tests, and the same class was already ruled Low. They go to the shared hydration-test cleanup (A-R298-ARCH-HYDRATE-HARNESS), which is now flagged three rounds running by two reviewers. No Critical, High or Medium finding is open, so new scope can start.

**Round 300 task (`current-task.md`)**
- **Feature:** right-click, Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key on the Middle East preview opens a one-item menu, "View in store". It is a real link that opens `/products/middle-east` in a new tab, so the Studio session survives. Other library items keep the browser's own menu.
- **Focus and keys:** every way of closing the menu returns focus to the item. Space and Enter open the link, and neither reaches the Studio shortcuts, so playback doesn't start.
- **Also:** one row in the `?` sheet, and doc 220 marked Completed.
- **Grants:** 9 paths (2 new files, 7 changed), each to be copied exactly from my sketch. No protected file is touched.
- **Approval:** Saba approved this scope on 2026-10-31, so it needs no AGREE note. The task still has the Ableton reference table, the product-designer framing, and the screen-budget and journey rows.

**What I verified on a scratch copy**
- Typecheck passes and Biome is clean. All 21 new tests pass.
- All 10 deliberate code breakages I tried turn the expected tests red.
- 113 of the 114 related test files pass. The one failure was IM24 (an insert-marker test unrelated to the menu), and only while my dev server and browser probes were loading the machine. It passes on its own 3 times out of 3 and passed in gate 299. The task tells A to run the set alone and to stop if IM24 fails alone.
- In a real browser at both viewports:
  - the menu opens on right-click and on the keyboard;
  - the new tab opens with no link back to the Studio;
  - focus returns to the item and the focus ring shows;
  - Space doesn't start playback;
  - a right-click moves an active preview to the clicked item, the same as a left click.
- On the current code, a right-click on any library item still shows the browser's own menu.

**Recorded, not blocking**
- **Question for Saba (SABA-Q-STUDIO-LINK-B):** should items without a store page keep the browser's own menu, and should a right-click switch the preview like a left click does?
- **Checkpoint request:** after round 300, I've asked root for one bounded frontend-architect review. It covers the hydration-test cleanup, the new menu duplicating the marker menu, and how the route sets focus.
- **Possible small bug, from reading code only:** pressing `?` while a menu is open may open the shortcut sheet on top of it.

**Next:** a regression round is due if round 301 is planned on or after 2026-11-02; otherwise NAME-AND-HINT. RETRO is at round 305.

I consulted the advisor twice, before writing and at the end. The final check led me to probe Space and preview behaviour in the browser and to add one more claim tag (K20). I consulted no new project agents; the round-297 product-designer and Ableton research was reused.
